assumptions: These are analyst-selected illustration points, NOT measured coupling, safe voltage settings, suggested power levels, or confidence bounds. Heater resistance is held at its rating-derived nominal value. Projection rectangles are geometry examples, not measured contact areas or physical bounds. The 1D model neglects spreading, contact resistance, storage, radiation, convection, wire/clamp/block conduction and any sand.
no_absolute_temperature_or_time_predicti: Unknown true contact/spreading area, cross-sample heat fraction, contact drops, heat capacities and boundary losses prevent a defensible apparatus temperature/time forecast.
